_readme: Floor 2 (Human Resources) text. Same rules as floor0/floor1.json: keep the ids; 'Name[expression]: ' sets the speaker; a line with no name is Donnie thinking.

lines: Human Resources. Might be the worst floor in the building.
And a queue on the sofas. Interviews. Poor sods.
Yuvie: Floor two. You're doing well, Donnie. For a man who mops.
Donnie[worried]: Let me talk to Betty.
Adi: She's fine! She's teaching me card tricks.
Irshad: She's teaching him how to lose.
Yuvie: Here's the deal. You cut the power. The whole building. Lights, lifts, computers, all of it.
Yuvie: Do that, and Betty goes home.
Donnie[angry]: That's it? That's what all this was for?
Donnie[angry]: I could have done that right at the start. There's a breaker room on this floor. It's one flip of a switch.
Yuvie: We know about the breaker room.
Irshad: A breaker cuts one floor. This one. The rest of the building wouldn't even notice.
Yuvie: The whole building runs off something called Plant Room 2B. You read that name yourself, downstairs.
Yuvie: Find out what it is, where it is, and how it's switched.
Adi: And don't get caught by HR. Irshad says HR is worse than prison.
Irshad: I've done both.
Donnie[worried]: ...Right.
[worried] That man doing laps of the floor. Head of HR. He looks at people like they're a rounding error.
If he sees me out there without my cart, I'm finished. Cart. Closet. Bottom left, if this floor's anything like the others.
The cart. My old friend. Nobody asks a man with a cart what he's doing.
Mops, bin bags, a single rubber glove. The cart's already out.
Already been through that.
[shocked] 'Northgate Power Plant. Unit 9, Northgate Industrial Estate, Riverside Road.'
Plant Room 2B isn't a room. It's a power station across town. They named a power station like a broom cupboard.
'Whole-building switch-over now done remotely from the Floor 2 breaker panel.'
[worried] The Floor 2 breaker panel. Huh.
There's more on the other tables in here.
[angry] The breaker room.
The BREAKER ROOM. The one I mentioned. On the phone. Out loud. Half an hour ago.
I said 'breaker room' and three grown kidnappers said 'no, Donnie, that's just one floor'. Wonderful. Fantastic.
Donnie[angry]: It's the breaker room. Plant Room 2B is the Northgate power station across town, and you switch it from the breaker room. On this floor. Which I said.
Yuvie: ...
Irshad: No.
Adi: No way. That's so insecure. A whole building on one switch next to a mop cupboard?
Donnie[angry]: It's GyaraCorp. Their password policy is a sticky note.
Yuvie: Then go and look at it. If it's that easy, someone will have put a lock on it.
Irshad: Someone always puts a lock on it.
The breaker panel. Floor 2 circuits. Big tempting switches.
[worried] The kidnappers were right. This does one floor. I'm not plunging HR into darkness for nothing. Tempting, though.
The panel wakes up. 'PLANT-2B SWITCHING. AUTHORISED DUTY LOGIN REQUIRED.'
Irshad was right. Someone always puts a lock on it.
A duty login. Reception keeps the duty list on this floor. The rota, the logins, the lot.
There'll be dozens of them. I'll need to know which one's the right one before I try anything.
'AUTHORISED DUTY LOGIN REQUIRED.' The reception computer has the duty list.
[worried] Hang on. If I touch the power, the employee terminal in the hallway goes dark with it.
Executive clearance first. Then the switch.
i.vidal. Northgate-0914.
'LOGIN ACCEPTED. PLANT-2B LINK: ONLINE. SWITCH WHOLE BUILDING? Y / N'
[shocked] It worked. One switch. The whole building.
The breaker panel. Humming. Smug.
The reception computer. Visitor badges, rotas, the duty list. Nothing I need. Yet.
One login. Ines Vidal. Plant engineer, night crew, been here since the plant was built.
Sorry, Ines. I'll put in a good word. Somehow.
[worried] Too many logins on that list. I'll find out more about who can switch the plant first. KODEX keeps the clues as I find them.
The printer's jammed on a policy page. 'BUILDING SYSTEMS: SWITCHING BETWEEN GRID AND PLANT 2B REQUIRES A LOGIN WHOSE ROLE ENDS IN "Engineer".'
Printed forty times, by the look of the floor. Someone in HR really wanted that read.
Special clean it is. Sifting the soil, carefully...
A coin. Just a coin. Somebody's rainy-day fund.
Just a plant. Soil, leaves, a faint smell of regret.
The projector's still on. The onboarding video. Let's see what new starters get told.
Video: Welcome to GyaraCorp! We're a family. A family with a disciplinary procedure.
Video: Our building runs on clean energy from our very own Northgate plant! Built in 2014 by our founding Night operations team.
Video: Inside the building we call it 'Plant Room 2B'. Legal said 'our own power station' sounded expensive.
Video: To this day, only the Night operations team switches Northgate. They're the best. Don't talk to them.
Video: Now, let's learn about mandatory fun.
Mandatory fun. Second viewing. Still mandatory.
Candidate: Sorry, are you staff? I've been here since seven. Nobody's offered me a glass of water.
Candidate: If I don't eat something I'm going to faint in that interview and they'll write 'fainted' on my form.
Candidate: Crisps. Anything. I'll owe you.
I've got crisps. I should have them in hand to hand them over.
Candidate: Oh, you absolute legend. Salt and vinegar. I'd hire you.
Candidate: Listen, while I was waiting I heard the HR lot by the desk. Arguing about the duty list.
Candidate: One of them said half the logins on it are dead. 'Anyone suspended or gone still shows up. Only the active ones actually work.'
Candidate: Then they talked about sacking someone at lunchtime and laughed. Do you think that's a red flag?
Donnie: It's a whole flag shop.
[neutral] Only the 'active' logins work. Good to know.
Candidate: Wish me luck. Actually don't, I've heard the HR lot laughing.
[shocked] Bram Kowal is being sacked today. His login gets switched off at noon. So it's not his.
And the rest of this file...
Everyone on Floor 1, sacked and replaced by a cheap call centre. The board hasn't been told.
The staff's pension savings, quietly spent on the power plant. The auditors haven't been told.
And the candidates on the sofas? The jobs went to friends weeks ago. The interviews are just for show.
[angry] If this got out, GyaraCorp would be in court by Friday.
I'm keeping a copy. Insurance.
A torch. Heavy, rubber, the good kind. Every janitor's best friend after the mop.
Dead. No power, no terminal.
Clearance for the Executive floor. JOINs. Tables that point at other tables. I'm basically IT now.
Now: the breaker room.
Yuvie: The panel lit up on your end, didn't it? We can hear it humming.
Yuvie: So. Can you switch the whole building from there or not?
[worried] (Tell them the truth?)
Yes. One switch, the whole building. It's ready.
No. It's locked. I can't do it.
Donnie[worried]: Yes. I can trip the whole building. It's ready.
Yuvie: Go ahead do it.
Donnie[worried]: Okay i did it. It's loading my request.
Adi: Liam's going to be so happy! His dad's whole building, dark, on a Tuesday!
Irshad: Adi.
Adi: What?
Donnie[shocked]: Liam? The CEO's son? He's behind this?
Yuvie: ...Fine. Yes. Liam wants his father's empire to have the worst day of its life. One day of chaos. That's the whole job.
Yuvie: And thank you, Donnie. We'll take it from here.
Irshad: Lights out.
Yuvie: Oh, and Donnie? Someone has to have done this. And you're standing next to the switch.
Yuvie: Security's been sent an anonymous tip about a janitor on Floor 2.
Donnie[worried]: No. It's locked. I can't do it.
Yuvie: Hm.
Adi: Liam's not going to like that. Liam REALLY wanted his dad's building dark today.
Irshad: Adi.
Adi: What? Oh. Oh no.
Donnie[shocked]: Liam? The CEO's son? He's behind this?
Yuvie: Liam wants his father's empire to have one very bad day. That's all. And you, Donnie, are lying to me.
Yuvie: Remember we said someone was keeping an eye on you? He just texted. You found the duty login.
{music:the_intern}Yuvie: Dan's new trainee. Ryker.
Donnie[shocked]: Ryker? That dumb intern?
Yuvie: He was just playing dumb.
Yuvie: You've stopped following orders, Donnie. So we're done with you.
Yuvie: Ryker's coming up to finish you. And once you're gone, nobody needs Betty either.
Irshad: That's not a figure of speech.
Donnie[shocked]: Wait. WAIT—
The line goes dead.
Ryker: FIRE! FIRE ON FLOOR TWO!
Ryker: Everybody out! Stairs, now! Leave your bags!
Ryker: And if anyone sees the janitor... tell him Ryker's looking for him.
Click. Clunk. Darkness.
[worried] The torch. There was one on a table in the long hallway.
The interview room locks from the outside. If I can get Ryker in there...
He won't come over that side by himself. I'll have to lead him with the torch, one flash at a time.
Clunk. Every light in the building, gone.
[worried] And security is on its way up for the janitor next to the switch.
The torch from the hallway table. Then the elevator. Quietly.
F: flash the torch where you're facing (anyone close enough to see it comes to look). E at a locker or big plant: hide.
[shocked] He's gone in. The door. NOW.
Ryker: Donnie? Is that you? Did you just LOCK me in?
Donnie[angry]: It locks from the outside. You'd know if you'd ever had a real interview.
Ryker: Very funny. Open the door, Donnie.
Donnie[angry]: You came up here to kill me.
Ryker: It's not personal. Liam pays well. Open the door and we'll call it even.
Donnie[angry]: No.
Ryker: Donnie.
Donnie[angry]: No. Sit in there and think about what you almost did.
Ryker: Fine. I'll call them myself.
Ryker: ...
Ryker: Oh, you're joking. Dead. My phone's dead. I spent all morning texting them about you.
Ryker: Okay. Okay. Listen. You're calling them anyway, right? Tell them something for me.
Ryker: Tell them I got into MagiCorp. The competition. They're going under, but one small misstep from Gyaracorp and that's all they need.
Ryker: Tell Liam I got their admin login. 'm.root', password 'Hocus-Pocus-77'. He'll know what it's worth. Just make sure I get paid.
Ryker: ...
Ryker: Please Donnie tell them.
Donnie: m.root. Hocus-Pocus-77. Got it.
Ryker: You'll tell them though, yeah? Donnie?
[neutral] Not a chance. Nobody hears about this. That's my card now, not his.
{music:stop}{music:once:call}Donnie dials the number. It rings once.
Yuvie: Ryker? Is it done?
Donnie[angry]: It's Donnie.
Yuvie: ...
Adi: He's ALIVE? Ryker had one job!
Yuvie: Well. That's a shame. Because I was just about to tell you that we're killing Betty.
Donnie[shocked]: Don't. Don't you touch her.
Irshad: (laughs)
Yuvie: Or what, Donnie? What are you going to do? Mop at us?
Donnie[angry]: I've got GyaraCorp's restructure file.
Donnie[angry]: Hundreds of people about to be sacked behind the board's back. The staff's pension money, quietly spent. Fake job interviews.
Donnie[angry]: Touch Betty and every newspaper in the country gets it. With Liam's name on top.
Irshad: ...
Adi: Oh, that's bad. That's really bad.
Yuvie: Liam wanted to ruin his father's DAY, Donnie. Not burn the whole company down. He still has to inherit it.
Donnie[angry]: Then let my daughter go.
Yuvie: ...
Yuvie: Let's meet in the middle.
Yuvie: Liam says one floor going dark is nothing. His father won't even hear about it until Friday.
Yuvie: He wants something that actually stings. Something with a price tag.
Irshad: The server room. Top floor.
Yuvie: Overheat it. Cook the servers. GyaraCorp spends a fortune replacing them, and Daddy has to explain it to the board.
Yuvie: Do that, and Betty goes home. You have my word.
Donnie[worried]: Your word. The people who kidnapped my daughter.
Yuvie: It's the only one on offer.
Yuvie: Anything else we should know, Donnie?
[worried] I should keep that to myself...
Donnie[neutral]: No. Nothing.
Donnie[angry]: Deal. I'm putting the lights back on, and I'm going up.
Clunk. Lights. Somewhere behind a locked door, Ryker kicks a filing cabinet.
The Executive floor. And then the server room.
The phone buzzes. Unknown number.
Yuvie: How have you still not been caught yet.
Donnie[angry]: You framed me.
Yuvie: We gave you a reason to keep moving.
Yuvie: And now we have a problem. I thought it was done Donnie but Liam isn't happy.
Adi: He said, and I quote, 'Dad will just take the afternoon off.'
Donnie[angry]: Here's my problem. I've got GyaraCorp's restructure file.
Donnie[angry]: Hundreds of people about to be sacked behind the board's back. The staff's pension money, quietly spent. Fake job interviews.
Donnie[angry]: Call off security, or every newspaper in the country gets it. With Liam's name on top.
Irshad: ...He's got us.
Yuvie: Liam wanted to ruin his father's day, Donnie. Not the whole company. He still has to inherit it.
Donnie[angry]: Then let my daughter go.
Yuvie: ...
Yuvie: Let's meet in the middle.
Yuvie: Security gets a second call. False alarm, a fault at the plant. And the lights come back on.
Yuvie: Then you do one more thing for us. Something that actually stings.
Irshad: The server room. Top floor.
Yuvie: Overheat it. Cook the servers. GyaraCorp spends a fortune replacing them.
Yuvie: Do that, and Betty goes home.
Donnie[worried]: ...Fine. Deal.
The lights come back on, floor by floor. The elevator dings like nothing happened.
The Executive floor. And then the server room.
No power, no elevator. And I'm not going anywhere until this is done.
No time for rooms. If I get cornered in there, that's it.
'You are not on my list.' Head of HR walks you to the exit. Very politely. Very firmly.
Ryker got you. He'll take your badge, your name, your place in this building. And you know what happens to Betty.
Security pins you to the carpet. You have been framed.
Walk with purpose. Purpose is billable.
I remember every face on this floor.
Smile. It's in your contract.
Interviews are in the room on the left. Please wait on the sofas.
Visitor? Badge? No? Janitor. Carry on.
If you're looking for the printer, it's in a mood.
Excuse me. Reception's computer is for reception.
That screen isn't for you, love.
Third interview this week. This one has a lawn.
They said 'business casual'. I don't know what that means.
I've prepared an answer for 'greatest weakness'. It's 'honesty'.
Do you think they'll ask about the gap in my CV? It's a big gap.
I got here an hour early. I regret it.
Is the G in the lawn meant to be a G?
I'm here for the 'Happiness Officer' role.
Shh. I'm visualising.
Where do you see yourself in five years? Not here, ideally.
Excuse me, we're mid-interview.
Sorry, this is a confidential interview.
Out, please. We're discussing his weaknesses.
My greatest strength is that I'm a perfectionist. I'm sorry.
Is the janitor part of the interview?
Don't touch the hot desks. They're hot.
Did you see the restructure memo? Nobody's seen the restructure memo.
That's not your desk.
Hands where I can see them, mop man.
We had a meeting about having fewer meetings.
I've been 'circling back' since March.
My performance review says 'present'. Just 'present'.
Shh, I'm pretending to type.
It's printed the same page forty times. I only wanted one.
Don't make eye contact with it.
Someone left the onboarding video on. It's been looping since nine.
If I watch 'mandatory fun' once more, I'm resigning.
My locker's been jammed since 2019. I just live with it.
The terminal at the end table? Nobody uses that. It just hums.
Lift's slow today. It's slow every day.
Going up? No? Nobody ever is.
Hey! Janitor! Stop!
Got him! Over here!
Torch on him!
You! You're not on my list!
Stop right there. Who signed off on you?
I'll need your name, your badge, and your resignation.
There you are.
Gotcha, Donnie.
Run, then!
'Conference room plant: special clean. Do NOT tip out the soil. Staff keep emergency coins in this one.'
Special cleaning. Finally, a puzzle for a janitor.
Interview room lock code: 7341. And it locks from the OUTSIDE.
[worried] Who designs an interview room like that? HR, that's who.
I'll remember that one.
Nice plant. I'll give it a wipe some other time.
Coin in. The machine thinks about it, like a bouncer.
Crisps. Salt and vinegar. A hungry man upstairs is about to love me.
[worried] The lock wants a code. I don't have it.
Somewhere on this floor there's a list of door codes. Too late now.
[worried] Hold on. Before I flip anything I want every card I can get.
There's still a computer in that open office I haven't read.
Not yet. The job on this floor comes first. Betty first, then the Executive floor.
Donnie[shocked]: That's Ryker's voice. He's here already.
Donnie[angry]: Clearing the floor so there's nobody to see what he does to me.
Donnie[angry]: Fine. If I can't see, he can't see either.
Donnie[angry]: The panel. Kill this floor's lights.
Click. Clunk. Darkness.
[worried] Good thing I grabbed the torch.
The interview room locks from the outside. If I can get Ryker in there...
He won't come over that side by himself. I'll have to lead him with the torch, one flash at a time.
Clunk. Every light in the building, gone. Somewhere a whole floor of people says 'oh for God's sake' at once.
[worried] And security is on its way up for the janitor next to the switch.
Torch on. To the elevator. Quietly.
Ryker: Donnie? Is that you? Are you here to let me out?
Donnie: No.
Ryker: ...Worth asking.
Security: Uh. Hi.
Security: So. Mr Liam just called. Says it was a false alarm. Fault at the plant.
Security: Sorry about the... you know. Chasing you round in the dark.
Donnie[angry]: Happens.
Security: Right. Well. As you were.
